title: 2 different sets, will work
text: 2 different sets, will work. Okay... so I ordered 2 sets of the 2.5 ounce cups.  I received:  one set of the 2.5 ounce and one set that was the wider smaller cup... 1.5 ounce.  Honestly, I'm ok with that.  I use them for sauces and/or butter at our seafood boils.  So I'm ok with it I guess. They are stainless... but pretty lightweight.  I plan to wash them in the dishwasher, top shelf and it should be fine.  If there are any issues, I'll update my review.
